sentences.text:
Sangam Verma @ Sangam Kumar Verma vs State Of U.P. Thru.
Prin. Secy. Home Lko. on 16 December, 2023

High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad, Lucknow Bench
?Neutral Citation No. - 2023:Ahc-Lko:83183
Court No. - 16
Case :- Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. - 14883 of 2023
Applicant :- Sangam Verma @ Sangam Kumar Verma

entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad, Lucknow Bench
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Opposite Party :- State Of U.P. Thru.

Counsel for Applicant :- Arvind Kumar,Ajay Deep Verma Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Subhash Vidyarthi,J.
1. Heard Sri Arvind Kumar, the learned counsel for the applicant as well as Sri Puneet Kumar, the learned A.G.A. for the State and perused the record.

2. The instant application has been filed seeking release of the applicant on bail in Case Crime No.
284 of 2023, under Section 420, 406, 467, 468, 471, 120-B I.P.C., registered at Police Station Kotwali Nagar, District Barabanki.

3. The aforesaid case has been registered on the basis of F.I.R. lodged on 07.03.2023 against six persons, including the applicant, in furtherance of an application under Section 156(3) Cr.P.C,
stating that on the suggestion of the applicant, the informant had made some investment in S.T.S company under allurement of 15% per month interest but after maturity, no amount was paid to the informant.
Sangam Verma @ Sangam Kumar Verma vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home Lko.

entities.text: Sangam Verma @ Sangam Kumar Verma vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home Lko
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: In the affidavit filed in support of the bail application, it has been stated that the applicant has been implicated in 59t other cases of similar nature and the learned counsel for the applicant has stated that the applicant has already been granted bail in 30 other cases.

5. The learned A.G.A. has opposed the prayer of the bail, but he could not dispute the aforesaid aspects of the matter.
6.

Having considered the aforesaid facts and circumstances of the case and keeping in view the fact that the grievance of the informant is regarding non refund of money invested in the company and the applicant does not hold any principle position in the company and that the applicant has already been granted bail in six other cases of similar nature and without making any observations which may affect the merits of the case, I am of the view that the applicant is also entitled to be released on bail.
7. Accordingly, this bail application stands allowed.

8.Let the applicant-Sangam Verma @ Sangam Kumar Verma be released on bail in the aforesaid case, on furnishing a personal bond and two sureties each in the like amount to the satisfaction of Magistrate/Court concerned, subject to the following conditions: -
(i) the applicant shall not tamper with the prosecution evidence;

(ii) the applicant shall not pressurize the prosecution witnesses;
(iii) the applicant shall appear on each and every date fixed by the trial court.

Order Date :- 16.12.2023 Pradeep/-
